text: I had the pleasure of teaching Raúl, who was an excellent student. I particularly appreciated his kindness, excellent communication, and consistently positive attitude. name: Valeriia Maliarenko
headline: Middle Business Analyst at DataArt
text:
I really enjoyed working with Raul. He is an attentive and proactive technical specialist who thinks creatively and independently and takes a thoughtful approach to investigating potential solutions.

As a Business Analyst, I particularly appreciated how thoroughly he investigated different options and how patiently he explained technical details to non-technical team members. He was always willing to help, whether it meant jumping on an urgent task or supporting other developers. He is also open to feedback and thoughtful about incorporating it into his work.

Raul is a great communicator who builds positive working relationships, including with client representatives. Beyond his technical expertise, he is a genuinely kind and approachable person who makes collaboration enjoyable.

I'd gladly recommend Raul to any team looking for a skilled, proactive, and collaborative technical specialist.

name: Gerson Scanapieco
headline: Engineering | Backend Focused
text: Working with Raul was an excellent experience. He has great technical skills and is a great team player, always striving to deliver great results. I highly recommend him, and look forward to work with him again.
